ria.m: Quick sync on inbound routing SLA — instead of a one-size 15s fallback, what about adaptive timeouts per campaign based on 95th percentile enrichment latency? Could reduce unnecessary fastlane assignments for heavy-media forms. Thoughts?
noah.b: Interesting. So each campaign would have a configured p95 threshold and we fallback at p95 + buffer? how do we surface that in HubSpot workflows?
ria.m: Exactly. Proposal: compute per-campaign p95 from the last 7 days, add 5s buffer, cap between 10s and 30s. On new leads evaluate: if enrich not finished by timeout -> tag fastlane and assign to pool. Campaigns opt-in.
lucy.g: Love that. For high-value campaigns like enterprise-demo we might want p99 + 10s instead — allow override. Also need to store the computed timeout in a HS property `routing_timeout_secs`.
noah.b: Can you sketch config? I can wire a small service that emits the p95 and pushes to HS via API.
ria.m: Sketch:
```yaml
adaptive_timeout:
  lookback_days: 7
  percentile: 95
  buffer_seconds: 5
  min_seconds: 10
  max_seconds: 30
  overrides:
    campaign_overrides:
      enterprise-demo: {percentile: 99, buffer_seconds: 10}
```
routing-ops-bot: Adaptive timeouts job scheduled: compute-timeouts (cron: @hourly). :gear:
noah.b: Nice. For rollout plan: 1) run in read-only mode and publish `routing_timeout_secs` to test campaigns 2) run synthetic traffic to validate p95 estimates 3) enable fastlane workflow for a single low-risk campaign 4) monitor claim success and SDR conversion delta before wider rollout.
lucy.g: Observability reqs: expose `adaptive_timeout_value`, `fastlane_rate`, `owner_claim_success`, and `lead_sla_violation` per campaign. Alert if fastlane_rate spikes >2% on revenue campaigns.
sdr-leads: Quick ops note from SDRs: if a lead is tagged fastlane=true we need a short tooltip in HS with instructions — "fastlane leads may lack enriched fields; do quick qualification then mark for follow-up enrichment."
ia: (typo)
noah.b: For safety with Salesforce dedupe we will set `SF_Source = 'adaptive_fastlane'` and `SF_DoNotMerge = true` while enrichment pending. Once enrichment finishes we patch the SF record. salesforce-sync-bot: Sync rule created (id: sync_adaptive_fastlane_v1).
ria.m: Perf test command I ran: `/tools/lead-sim --campaign website-ebook --count 5000 --enrich-tail-prob 0.02 --enrich-median 6 --enrich-tail 45` — p95 computed ~18s so with buffer => 23s; fastlane rate in sim was 0.9% vs 2.8% at static 15s. Logs: https://internal/ci/lead-adaptive/2932
lucy.g: That delta is promising. Can you open an RFC and include the sim results and safety checklist? I'll prep dashboard panels.
ria.m: Will do. RFC will include SQL used for p95 calc, HS API push script, workflow YAML, and rollback plan. If all good we'll canary on `website-ebook` and `trial-start` next week. :rocket:
